data.gender_notes: Aatik is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'aa-taaka', meaning 'to be strong or firm'. In Islamic tradition, this name symbolizes strength and resilience. The name Aatik carries the meaning “Strong, Firm” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aatik usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, firm and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aatik total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
